item.title: Ocean's Deadliest Predators — Full Shark Documentary Marathon
item.description:
A full marathon of our shark footage archive — great whites, tiger sharks, bull sharks, and the ocean's apex predators in action, back to back, with live commentary breaking down the biology behind every hunt.
This isn't just "scary shark" clips — it's real predator behavior, explained in real time.
💬 Drop questions in chat — we'll pull up footage on request and break down what's actually happening.
🦈 Subscribe for more ocean predator deep-dives: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC41xXhw22o6Q2I2pTKB2kOg ⏰ Live for 12 hours — join anytime, we'll recap for latecomers every 20 minutes.
